description: Original Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory multiplayer packs

sources.instructions: setup stages etmain/pak0.pk3, etmain/pak1.pk3, and etmain/pak2.pk3 from the official Splash Damage freeware full-game archive. Copying those same three files manually is also accepted. pak0.pk3 alone is not enough. There is no Steam login path. These packs are separate from the ET: Legacy engine download.

manual_reason: Import requires a complete compatible distribution and manual staging. See assets requirements for this game.
